derivation_disclosure: Frozen after r7.68a showed high prototype-only source-macro accuracy but soft-target optimization reduced fixed-binary positive recall, and after r7.69 distance auxiliary failed. No r7.71 result was observed. Bangkok/r7.70 is excluded from both fitting and pass/fail.

pair_construction.matching: for every positive row choose the same-source negative with minimum absolute timestamp gap; ties choose earlier timestamp then manifest index; negative reuse allowed
pair_construction.difference: 132-D positive relation vector minus matched negative relation vector
pair_construction.split: leave one complete source_id and all its pairs out before fitting

probe.weighting: equal source mass and equal pair mass within source
